scripts.reference:refresh: bun run platform -- resolve && bun run platform -- compose && bun run platform -- adapt && bun run platform -- verify --lane all && bun run platform -- lock && bun run platform -- explain
scripts.demo:quickstart: bun run platform -- init --reset && bun run reference:refresh
scripts.demo:governance: bun run demo:quickstart && bun run platform -- artifacts --paths --kind governance
scripts.demo:closed-loop: bun run demo:quickstart && bun run platform -- verify --lane all && bun run platform -- artifacts --paths --kind governance && bun run platform -- explain --json --compact
scripts.dogfood:governance: bun run dogfood:reference && bun run platform -- artifacts --paths --json --kind governance
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.check:changed: bun run typecheck && bun run test:changed
scripts.check:full: bun run typecheck && bun run test:all
scripts.jscpd: jscpd platform/ scripts/ -o report/jscpd --reporters html,console --format typescript,javascript --ignore "**/node_modules/**,**/dist/**,**/*.test.ts,**/*.d.ts,**/upgrade/**,.tmp/**" --min-lines 5 --min-tokens 50 --absolute
scripts.depcruise:graph: depcruise platform/ --config .dependency-cruiser.json --output-type dot | dot -T svg -o report/dep-graph.svg
scripts.arch:check: bun run depcruise && bun run jscpd
scripts.preflight: bun run depcruise && bun run jscpd && bun run discover
